name: andorlabs
description: And/or Labs skills for GTM, positioning, brand and building in public.

plugins.name: stack-maximizer
plugins.description: Audits your internal GTM software stack from local evidence (receipts, website tags, DNS, browser usage, repos, AI chat logs), confirms it with you once, then scores keep/kill deterministically, gives every kept tool one core function, flags missing B2B essentials, and writes a 30/60/90 roadmap.

plugins.name: fix-my-positioning
plugins.description: Grades B2B startup positioning against five non-overlapping frameworks (Dunford, JTBD/ODI, Raskin, VPC, Challenger) on a 0–10 scale, applies Fletch PMM execution-layer critique to the homepage, and generates three alternative positioning variants with H1 + subhead + features + tradeoff analysis.

plugins.name: saas-grader
plugins.description: Score SaaS websites against 47 research-backed optimization rules from peer-reviewed marketing science. One command: /saas-grader:saas

plugins.name: rand-brief
plugins.description: Analyzes an existing brand the way Paul Rand would: name semantics first, then the idea: and writes a one-page design brief proposing a mark direction, typeface pairings, and a flat color palette, argued as a single confident recommendation in the style of Rand's NeXT presentation booklet.

plugins.name: build-in-public
plugins.description: Observes your Claude Code sessions and git commits, surfaces share-worthy moments, and drafts privacy-gated, algorithm-tuned X and LinkedIn posts in your voice. Never auto-publishes.
